annotations.text: /costs.html — Concept A: Digest (stacked, single column). Content = the LIVE database's real, current state (0 meetings, 0 automation_events, no real Ask-Agent/Meeting/Chief-of-Staff invocations exist yet) — this is literally what the page renders on day one, not a fabricated empty state. Recommended: ship this layout.

/costs.html — Concept B: Two-column dashboard. Content is ILLUSTRATIVE (clearly labeled on the artboard) since the live DB has no real data for these paths — demonstrates the coverage-gap disclosure (full/partial/zero coverage) CTO's spec needs reviewed. Not recommended as the primary layout — see review for why.
Meeting Detail — Concept 1: cost sprinkled inline (top meta line + per-position-card badges + follow-up panel badges). Spreads cost across 3 existing components.

Meeting Detail — Concept 2: one dedicated Cost panel, placed right under the header (mirrors Milestone A Task Detail's summary-strip precedent). Position cards and follow-up panels stay untouched. Recommended.
